metadata.scenario: A new customer questions an unexpected fee on their bill for services they did not request. Category: Billing. Flags: billing_dispute.

transcription.text: Thank you for calling CareFirst Home Health, this is Margaret. How can I help you today? Hi, Margaret. This is Susan Garcia. I was referred by my father's pulmonologist. Hi, Susan! Nice to meet you. How can I assist you today? Well, I have a bit of a problem. I received the bill yesterday, and there's a charge for a service we didn't request. I’m sorry to hear that. Can you tell me more about the charge? Yes, there's a $95 fee for wound care management, but we never ordered that service. My father only needs help with his COPD and breathing treatments. I understand your concern, Susan. Let me pull up your account and see what might have happened. Thank you, I appreciate it. I just want to make sure we’re only paying for the services we actually receive. Absolutely, that's important. Please hold for just a moment. Alright, I see that the charge for wound care was mistakenly added. It appears there was a miscommunication on our end. Oh, I see. So it should be removed from the bill? Yes, we can certainly adjust that for you. I’ll make a note to have it removed. Thank you. Can you also confirm that my father is scheduled for his breathing treatments? Yes, I can confirm that his next session is on Thursday at 10 AM. Perfect. I just want to ensure everything is in order. Absolutely, Susan. I'll send you a revised bill after the adjustment. That sounds good. Is there anything else we need to discuss today? Well, I noticed you might also benefit from personal care assistance. Would you be interested in discussing that option? Actually, I hadn’t thought about it. What does that involve? It includes help with bathing, dressing, and personal hygiene at a rate of $28 to $35 per hour. That sounds helpful, especially if he needs extra support. I can have a care coordinator reach out to you to discuss options that best fit your father's needs. Would you like me to set that up? Yes, please. That would be great. Perfect. I’ll have Lisa Chen contact you for a follow-up. Thank you for your help today, Margaret. You're welcome, Susan! We appreciate your trust in us. Have a great day! You too, bye! Goodbye!
